js: const r = (el) => { const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(b.left*10)/10, Math.round(b.top*10)/10, Math.round(b.width*10)/10, Math.round(b.height*10)/10]; };

const snap = () => ({ title: r($('#view-mine .page-title')), note: r($('#mine-note')), search: r($('#mine-search')), seg: r($('#mine-sort')), groups: r($('#mine-group')), fav: r($('#filter-fav')), exp: r($('#export-all')), mainW: $('main').clientWidth, gutter: $('main').offsetWidth - $('main').clientWidth });
const diff = (a, b) => Object.keys(a).filter(k => JSON.stringify(a[k]) !== JSON.stringify(b[k])).map(k => k + ' ' + JSON.stringify(a[k]) + '->' + JSON.stringify(b[k]));
const step = async (name, fn) => { await fn(); await __wait(300); out[name] = diff(base, snap()); };
await step('search zzz', () => { const s = $('#mine-search'); s.value = 'zzz'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); });
await step('search cleared', () => { const s = $('#mine-search'); s.value = ''; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); });
// switching views: the page must not move sideways

const pos = {}; for (const v of ['catalog', 'mine', 'scene', 'settings']) { __nav(v); await __wait(250); const pg = $('.view.active .page').getBoundingClientRect(); pos[v] = [Math.round(pg.left), Math.round(pg.width), $('main').offsetWidth - $('main').clientWidth]; }
// a card's size must not change when it is pointed at
const card = $('#mine .char'); const b0 = r(card); card.classList.add('fh'); await __wait(250); out.hoverCardMoved = JSON.stringify(b0) !== JSON.stringify(r(card));
